faq.q: When does the PhonePe inactivity fee come into effect?
faq.a: The PhonePe inactivity fee is applicable from June 2026. If your wallet has been inactive for 365 days as of this month, you may start receiving notices for deductions.

A PhonePe wallet is considered inactive if there have been no financial transactions made *from the wallet* for 365 consecutive days. Logging in, checking balance, or making UPI payments (not using wallet balance) do not count as activity.

faq.q: Can the inactivity fee lead to a negative wallet balance?
faq.a: No, PhonePe has clarified that the wallet balance will never go into negative territory. If your wallet balance is less than ₹100, the entire remaining amount will be debited, bringing the wallet balance to zero.

faq.q: How can I check my PhonePe wallet activity?
faq.a: You can check your PhonePe wallet activity by opening the PhonePe app, going to the 'My Money' or 'Wallets' section, and then viewing your transaction history specifically for the PhonePe wallet.

faq.q: Is there a way to close my PhonePe wallet?
faq.a: Yes, you can typically close your PhonePe wallet through the app's help and support section or by contacting customer service. Ensure your wallet balance is zero before initiating the closure process.

faq.q: Do other digital wallets charge inactivity fees?
faq.a: Yes, PhonePe is not the first to introduce such a fee. Other platforms like MobiKwik and Airtel Payments Bank have also had similar inactivity or maintenance charges for dormant wallets.

faq.q: Does this fee apply to UPI transactions via PhonePe?
faq.a: No, this inactivity fee applies only to the PhonePe wallet balance. UPI transactions made directly from your linked bank account through the PhonePe app are not affected by this policy.
